主要内容: The document is a Form 6-K filing by Royal Bank of Canada, which is a report to the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) under U.S. securities laws. The filing includes information about the issuance of Senior Global Medium-Term Notes, Series E, with a principal amount of $9,120,000. The notes are leveraged equity index-linked notes due on July 31, 2013, with a pricing date of January 9, 2012, and a settlement date of January 17, 2012. The filing also includes legal opinions from Norton Rose OR LLP and Morrison & Foerster LLP regarding the validity of the notes under Canadian and New York law. The report was signed by authorized officers of the Royal Bank of Canada on January 17, 2012.
